description: Dear dart experts and those who want to become dart experts. Please showcase your talents to the fullest on this thrilling dart journey. Collect and enrich your dart warehouse with the goal of overcoming all challenges. Experience the joy of different dart competitions.

title: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion
description:
Discover the exciting world of juicy fruits! The task is simple: connect identical fruits to create ever larger and tastier associations, heading towards the treasured watermelon.

- Click on the field
- Connect identical fruits
- Create combinations to get bigger fruits.
- Reach the last level
- Don't let the container overfill
- Earn money for new skins and try to pass with them ???

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Merge Brick Breaker
description: Welcome to Merge Brick Breaker, the ultimate fusion of ball merging and brick-breaking action! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure that challenges your strategic skills and reflexes.

title: Detective - Logic Puzzles
description:
Become a Detective! Solve logic puzzles to find the criminal! 
Lots of levels and interesting stories!

You will have to solve a lot of different cases, in this you will be helped by the method of deduction known to all detectives.

title: Treasure Champion - Chest Capture
description: Dive into the exciting world of stickmen in this exciting team game! Your task is to capture the chest in the center of the field and deliver it to the base together with your team, avoiding traps and tricky moves of your opponents. Each successfully delivered chest brings points, and the dynamics of the game keep you in suspense until the last second.

title: Spin Shot Siege
description: In "Spin Shot Siege," take control of a gunner on a rotating tower. Enemy tanks orbit around you in the opposite direction. Each level has tanks following paths like diamonds, circles, rectangles, or triangles. Aim carefully and destroy all tanks before running out of ammo. Can you master the spin and win the siege?

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Antistress - Simulator Of Sequins DIY
description: ASMR sequin simulator game offers a realistic stress relief experience. Immerse yourself in the world of sequins, where every touch feels real and sensory. The antistress simulator will allow you to relax while enjoying the visual and tactile effects.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist
description: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist is a very sophisticated makeup game. This game has an eye makeup  theme that is very targeted. This game has 26 levels, which means there are 26 types of eye makeup  for you to choose from. No matter what style of makeup you prefer, you can find one that satisfies  you in this game. Want to know more about this game?

title: Bubble Piggies
description: Bubbles Piggies is an engaging bubble shooter game with 50 levels. Free all piggies to complete the levels. When there are no piggies left in the tube the level will drop down 1 floor. Each level will face challenging features like the sleeping piggy, the hidden piggy, the powerup bubble, the moving bubble and more.

title: Falling Man
description:
Fall for fun in this addictive hypercasual game!
Ready for a wild ride? Join the thief as he falls from dizzying heights, dodging obstacles and collecting coins in this addictive hypercasual game. With two distinct locations to explore and endless possibilities for high scores, the fun never ends in this exciting game.

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Pretty Sheep Run
description: Play a fun arcade game in Pretty Sheep Run. You guide an adorable little sheep dashing across endless platforms. Keep your sheep running while cleverly avoiding dangerous traps. Control your sheep running to shoot different numbered doors. Change the numbers into positive numbers. Thus increasing the gun's DMG, ATK SPD, etc. Reach the finish line and shoot farther to get rewards. Keep buying guns and merging the same two guns to get upgrades.

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: Makeup Trends: Then And Now
description: Step into the exciting world of makeup transformations with  Makeup Trends: Then And Now! Join influencer Kiki as you explore the evolution of beauty trends from the early 2000s to 2024. Experiment with y2k-VSCO and emo-euphoria dark looks, mixing vibrant eyeshadows, bold lip colors, and edgy styles. Customize unique hairstyles and accessories to complete your makeup looks. With endless possibilities to mix and match, become a beauty trendsetter in this fun and engaging game for girls.

title: Fury of the Steampunk Princess
description: Welcome to the world of the future, where style and survival go hand in hand. Help the girl create unique outfits that combine elements of post-apocalyptic chaos and steampunk technology. From armored corsets to steam accessories - the possibilities for customizing clothes in the game are extensive. Get a boost of energy for creativity and self-expression in a world where, even after the end of the world, style remains important for survival!

title: Race It: Car Racing
description: Play Race It: Car Racing free online and jump into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Challenge rivals in intense 1v1 city races, swipe to drift, time your boosts, and outsmart opponents in a skill-based brain game of reflex and control. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for quick breaks and nonstop racing action.

title: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game
description: Color Wars is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle three opponents to control the most territory before time runs out. Deploy powerful cards like Warrior, Ranger, Thunder, and Wizard, each with unique abilities. Earn trophies by ranking in the top two and use gold to upgrade your cards. Plan smart moves, outplay rivals, and dominate the battlefield.

title: Around Elbrus
description: In the game “Around Elbrus”, the player controls a character who rushes down Mount Elbrus. The goal of the game is to collect all the coins and overcome various obstacles such as rocks, cliffs and avalanches. The game features beautiful graphics and addictive gameplay and is suitable for players of all ages.

title: Squid Game: Craft Runner
description:
Join the fun in Squid Game Subway Craft! Craft your way through obstacles and race along the railway tracks in a Minecraft-style world. Face exciting challenges, meet cool characters, and show your skills as you survive the ultimate test in this action-packed game inspired by Squid Game!"

Let me know if this works for you!se!

title: Word Connect Puzzle
description: Word Connect Puzzle is a relaxing yet brain-boosting word game. Swipe letters to form hidden words, unlock new packs, and watch the difficulty rise as your vocabulary grows. Earn stars, complete daily challenges, and use hints when you’re stuck. Play offline anytime, enjoy clean visuals and smooth controls, and chase streak bonuses for higher scores. Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle runs—smart, simple, and satisfying for all ages.

title: Hexa Tap Away
description: Hexa Tap Away is a sleek one-direction hex puzzle. Drag tiles to move them in the only direction they can travel, create space, and clear the board. Each level adds trickier layouts, blockers, and tight corridors that demand planning ahead. Short, snackable stages, smooth controls, and a clean look make it easy to start and hard to stop. Stuck? Try a hint or rethink your route and there’s always a smarter move!

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: Toilet Pin
description: Join the daily story of the toilet boy in the monster letter world. This new pin pulling game is for you. Let's explore Alphabet Lore with extraordinary characters! In the land of evil letters, you will have a chance to meet various amazing characters and powers of them: evil B ready to punch in your face, Angry C biting with sharp teeth, boring F with a gun, Crazy Z with fire, monster D who loves lava ....

title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: Quiz Master
description:
Quiz Master is a fast-paced casual quiz game where you race against the clock—and other players—to prove you’ve got the wittiest brain in town.
Each match drops you into a question showdown spanning everything from pop culture and geography to brain-rot challenges.
When you answer a question correct you get 1 Block that will save you. If you pick the wrong answer you will stay where you are.
The water rises so make sure to answer correctly or you get eaten by the sharks.

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description:
A fun and dangerous game about Rainbow Friends!
You are in a dangerous place. You need to survive 5 days and 5 nights, but the deadly obstacle will be the terrifying and bloodthirsty monsters Rainbow Friends!
Complete all the missions, move fast, perform actions carefully and run away from the monstrous monsters!

title: Commando Force 2
description: Get ready for a gun games adventure with Commando Force 2! Jump into a fast-paced shooter! Join the fun and dive into the action! Unlock new weapons, dominate the maps, and show everyone what you’ve got!

title: 100 Rooms Escape
description: This is a brain-burning and challenging escape room online game. Interesting gameplay so you won't get bored. You need to open 100 doors to escape the room. Interact with objects and solve puzzles to complete the tasks in the escape game. Solve the puzzles, and take inventory of the hidden items. You may use them to open the room, move on to the next level, use your skills, and do whatever it takes to escape.

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description:
Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and fun 2D arcade puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the girl's revenge on her lover. The heroine needs to find objects and use them to make her boyfriend's life hell.  
You need to collect various items to make a trap with them.

title: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle is a fun and engaging puzzle game that challenges your spatial imagination and color-matching skills! Match colorful screws to their corresponding nuts and watch as your puzzle-solving skills bring vibrant images to life. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of brain-teasing fun with a visually satisfying reward at the end of each challenge. Test your logic, precision, and creativity in this unique puzzle-solving adventure!

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
description: “Find It In The Haunted Mansion” is a finding style game, where you are a detective and need to find all the keys hidden in each part of the house to complete all the levels.

title: Dragon Escape
description: The cute dinosaur wants to reach the exit by eating Sandwich in the area protected by robots. If you want to help him, try to pass the levels by using laser traps without entering the robots' field of vision.

title: Hexa Tile Master
description: Welcome to Hexa Tile Master! Drag stacks of hex tiles from the bottom of your screen to empty spots on the board. Watch as similar tiles merge into bigger stacks, and collect stacks of 10 or more matching tiles to clear them. Your goal is to clear all the hex tiles before time runs out. Each level gets more challenging, but don't worry—fun animations and exciting rewards will keep you engaged. Enjoy the strategic fun and see how far you can go!

title: Epic Mine
description: In the game, you will need to correctly organize the smelting of resources in order to sell everything as profitably as possible. At the same time, it is important not to forget that resources should also be spent on skill upgrades! The game values quick reactions, but the ability to earn well will allow you to overcome any difficult spot in the game with patience and intelligence.

title: Super Tank Hero
description: Super Tank Hero is an action shooting game. You can drive a tank to shoot and fight on the battlefield, usually facing seven enemies and obstacles. You need to collect soldiers before the battle, they'll join your team and help you fight. You can also find energy and Life on the battlefield to increase your speed or power. When you are able to fight, follow the instructions to find your opponent and fire at him until you beat him.

title: Supermarket Manager Simulator
description: Supermarket Manager Simulator is a business game. Have you ever fantasized about running your supermarket in your childhood?  Play as the store manager in this game and stock up on a variety of goods, from chips and fries to meats, burgers, vegetables, and fruits. From stocking, and shelving to selling, you will be the one to take care of it!  Don't hesitate to start your entrepreneurial journey now and become a great store tycoon!

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Isometric Escape
description: Isometric is an escape game where you solve a series of puzzles to escape from isometric rooms. Find all the useful objects and use your logic and memory to solve the riddles.

title: Furry Wedding Proposal
description: Hi, young stylist! You will find a very unusual couple in love - a brutal fox and a feminine bunny - who are preparing for their future wedding. They dream of looking stunning on this holiday and you will become their main assistant in this exciting adventure! You have to dress the characters in beautiful wedding dresses, choose stylish hairstyles for them and apply light makeup. Create, fantasize and create a fairy tale!

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Hexa GO!
description: A puzzle game about dropping hexagons from grid. To do this, use a bomb and explode all the tiles nearby! Click on the rotate-button and swap the tiles! And also use other special tiles!

title: Mahjong Classic
description: Relax and challenge your mind with Mahjong Classic, a timeless tile-matching puzzle game with a beautiful, traditional aesthetic. Enjoy the calming backdrop and classic gameplay as you match identical tiles to eliminate them from the board. The goal is simple: clear all the tiles to win the game. But it’s not just about matching any tiles—only the free tiles on the edge can be selected, adding a layer of strategy and focus to your gameplay.

title: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top
description: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top is an addictive one-touch climbing game where you control a cute bolt on a mission to climb as high as possible! Just tap and hold to rise — the higher you go, the harder it gets. Can you set a new record?

title: Wild West Match 2: The Gold Rush
description: Wild West Match 2 immerses you in the thrilling Gold Rush era of the Wild West! Match three or more gold nuggets, cowboy hats, horseshoes, and other treasures to earn points and unlock new levels. Use Dynamite to clear obstacles or reveal hidden gold! With hundreds of challenging levels, you’ll dig through the Wild West to find hidden treasures and secrets. Ready to strike it rich? Join the Gold Rush adventure now!

title: Bloom Within: A life simulator
description:
The simulator of a pregnant mother allows you to fully experience the whole process of pregnancy.
In this anime game you have to play the role of a girl who has a loving husband and a child under her heart, who is waiting for her birth. Take care of yourself, give birth, take care of your baby and raise a healthy baby.

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

title: Timewalker: Survive!
description: Time Walker: Survive – Embark on a thrilling journey through apocalyptic landscapes in this fast-paced 2D top-down survival game! As a Timewalker, battle relentless hordes of zombies across different eras, fighting for survival against increasingly intense waves of the undead.

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: Blocksss
description:
Blocksss is challenging, exciting and sometimes infuriating minimalist puzzle game. Enjoy the world's most beloved puzzle game for FREE!
Easy to play, and pleasurable game for all ages.

title: Academy Assault
description: Cael has decided to challenge Rin, the strongest in the academy that he goes to. She will only accept his challenge after he has defeated the other students in Imperium Academy.

title: Volley Bean
description: Volley Bean is a simple and easy to learn volleyball game. With simple controls and fast paced gameplay volleyball never been more entertaining. The variety of boosts spawn randomly on the screen doubles the fun.

title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a funny and addictive casual puzzle game. Here you should help a clever stickman with many funny ways to solve puzzles and steal target items. The rich and varied game scene contains many unexpected obstacles and traps, testing your intelligence and logical thinking. Each level of the game is a unique challenge. To make flexible movements of the character to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and successfully steal the target item.

title: Fishing the Russian Way
description:
Embark on a journey through Central Russia: picturesque rivers and lakes, different types of fish, and the exciting process of fishing. Improve your tackle, control your rod, decide the fate of your catch, and add to your collection of rare finds.

Use your car to discover new locations, complete tasks, participate in tournaments, and receive daily rewards. Freedom of choice and the path to becoming a true fishing master await you!

title: Perfect Piano Magic
description: Perfect Piano Magic is a fun casual game. If you are a big fan of Piano Magic games, then this is a game you can't afford to miss! The gameplay of this game is extremely similar to Piano Magic, you need to shoot the blocks with a gun to capture the beat. You have three chances per game, start now and feel the real music when you click the blocks, enjoy the beats, and get ready to experience the delightful music and become a rhythm master!

title: Turbo Stunt Racing
description: Experience high-speed thrills in Turbo Stunt Racing! Perform epic stunts, race fierce rivals, and upgrade unique cars in this 3D arcade racer packed with action, traps, and ramps. Master precision driving and dominate every level!

title: Merge Muscle
description: Create the most powerful gym, connect athletes!  A large gym is at your disposal. Your task is to get new athletes, combine similar ones to get more powerful athletes. The most powerful athletes can be taken to a boxing competition. You need to click as often and quickly as possible to defeat your opponent in a difficult battle.

title: Gift Merge Santa World Tour
description:
Gift Merge: Santa World Tour

Help Santa spread Christmas joy across the globe!
Tap to generate gifts, merge identical items to craft new toys, and fulfill children’s wishes to raise each country’s happiness. Travel from snowy towns to sunny beaches, unlocking new festive destinations. Merge, match, and make magic — the more joy you spread, the closer Santa gets to completing his world tour!

title: Run from Baba Yaga
description:
Run from Baba Yaga is a potentially endless runner in which player has to collect as much treasures as possible and run as long as possible while Baba Yaga is trying to catch up with them.

During the chase, Baba Yaga gradually gets stronger: her movespeed and damage increase.An outstanding result can be achieved if player reaches the last stage of the game by running 400 hexes (hexagonal pieces of path).

title: FaceChart
description: Do you dream of creating wild, fabulous looks like your favorite artists on social media? Dive into the enchanting realm of Face Chart! Wondering what a face chart is? It's your chic canvas to plan the next jaw-dropping, glamorous look. Grab a piece of paper and let it be your pocket-sized playground—experiment with new colors you hesitated to wear, pick and mix diverse designs for an endless array of possibilities.

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Real GT Racing Simulator
description: "Real GT Racing Simulator" offers the ultimate driving experience for racing enthusiasts. Get behind the wheel of meticulously detailed cars and race on stunningly realistic tracks. Compete in high-speed circuits, fine-tune your vehicle for peak performance, and rise through the ranks to become a true racing legend. This game emphasizes authentic driving physics, customizable cars, and a variety of racing modes—from casual races to full championship tournaments.

title: Hunt And Seek
description: Ready for a challenge of intellect and strategy? In Hunt And Seek, enter an adventure world filled with puzzles that will stimulate your brain as you search for hidden characters! This game offers endless fun and challenges, suitable for boys and puzzle enthusiasts! At the beginning of each level, an arrester is randomly selected. At the beginning of each level, a random arrester is selected to become a giant and start hunting.

title: Zombie Road
description:
In a world where the dead walk, the real challenge is getting smash them all with your car.
Even the apocalypse can’t stop the Zombie driver. Outfit your car with defenses, smash through the undead and reach the end.

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: Crazy Stunts 3D
description: Get behind the wheel and conquer extreme tracks! Jump from ramps, compete with players, complete modes and unlock new cars!

title: Crocodilo Tralalero Run
description: Crocodilo Tralalero Run is a fast-paced platformer where your Crazy fiends runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Unlock and customize your Crazy fiends in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Crocodilo, Tralalero, Tsung Tsung and others characters offers fun for all ages!

title: Bubble Blitz Galaxy
description: Welcome to Bubble Blitz Galaxy! Aim and shoot bubbles towards similar ones to collect them while ensuring they stay away from the borderline. Experience two exciting modes: In Arcade Mode, strive to survive as long as possible and score as much as you can. In Challenge Mode, survive and achieve target scores, facing new challenges one after another. Get ready for an exhilarating bubble-blasting adventure!

title: Leap of Life
description:
"Leap of Life" is a short game that offers a true challenge! Every jump you make is a step towards victory but also a step towards losing a life.
Your task is to preserve each jump, calculating your path precisely to avoid depleting all your lives.

title: Pixel Path
description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Toilet Time
description: Toilet Time is more than just a puzzle game—it’s a hilarious journey into the quirkiest parts of everyday life. Challenge yourself with toilet-inspired puzzles that combine creativity, wit, and humor.

title: Hidden Object: Emily's Case
description:
A detective adventure set in Victorian London.

Search for hidden objects, uncover clues, and investigate the disappearance of a young girl. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, and step by step reveal the secrets of the old city.

title: Sprunki Monster Music Beats
description: Sprunki Monster Music Beats is a music game where popular characters create unique compositions. Combine sounds, create melodies, and enjoy!

title: Head Soccer Arena
description: Head Soccer Arena takes you into a fast-paced football world! Play 2-player matches on the same device, dive into quick games, or rise through 15 leagues in Career Mode. Win matches, collect coins and diamonds, and upgrade your power-ups—ice, lightning, anvil, big head, and more! Unlock new characters and dominate the field with strategy, skill, and speed. Every match is a step toward football glory!

title: Lulus Fashion World
description: Welcome to Lulu’s Fashion World. Can you battle to become the top fashion designer? Collect stars, progress through cities and events. Choose from clothes you own from plenty categories. Style outfits your way and save them to use whenever you like. The combinations of clothing and makeup are at your fingertips to experiment and create unique trends that could become the new fashion trend. Experiment with new looks and create a fad. So, are you ready to be the new fashion icon ?

title: Bubbly Lab
description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle game where you have to catch all the adorable bubbles in the laboratory. Use a super strong vacuum cleaner to get the bubbles into the flask. Use your logic to move lab items to help you get bubbles. Solve interesting puzzles in this fun and unique game!

title: Save the Daddy
description:
Get ready to unlock a world of tricky puzzles and brain teasers in Save the Daddy. Each level is unique and carefully designed to challenge your mind and test your IQ. Pull the pin in the right order and help the man escape from dangerous monsters & obstacles safely and thoughtfully.
Play each level very cautiously by analyzing your move before pulling the pin. As you progress, levels increase in difficulty which will make you game challenging and earn more rewards.

title: Doodle Dino Run
description: Doodle Dino Run delivers an addictive running adventure where you control a cute dinosaur, avoid dangers, and push your distance record farther every time you play. Featuring smooth side-scrolling gameplay, precise jump timing is essential to survive. Packed with action, this dinosaur adventure challenges your reflexes as the speed continuously increases.

title: Cool Cars: racing at altitude
description:
Cool Cars: racing at altitude is an exciting racing game in which you can buy cars, build your own garage and compete with other players.

Earn points by collecting bonuses on a straight track, compete with other players to complete special tracks against the clock, equip your auto repair shop and collect cool cars!
In the game you will find a large number of cars, exciting tracks, your own garage with purchased cars, the ability to change the environment to suit you and much more.

title: Dreamy Jewel
description: If you put three or more jewel of thesame type together vertically or horizontally, they'll disappear! Special blocks appear when four or more are aligned and erased. Mixing effects when special blocks are crossed with each other!

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: House Deep Clean Sim
description:
House Deep Clean Sim is a home-themed cleaning game with a strong sense of experience. It has 9 scenes for you to clean, which are fence, sculpture, trampoline, pool, robot, fountain, ground,
car, and dining table. Not only does it have a rich scene, but it also has everything you need for a clean game, such as full 3D effects, resizable nozzle size, and the ability to move around at will.  Try it if you are interested. Have fun.

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description:
Drive Nubik along exciting tracks. Jump over gaps, go around obstacles and reach the finish line! Lots of different levels, drive a motorcycle, get there without destruction.

You have to drive a motorcycle with a noob and get to the finish line.
Jump over gaps and go around obstacles at high speed.
Exciting levels are waiting for you!

title: Pet Runner
description: Pet Runner is a fast-paced platformer where your pet runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Play in Endless Mode for infinite fun or tackle unique challenges in Level Mode. Use up to three lives, hit checkpoints, and complete daily challenges to earn coins. Unlock and customize adorable pets in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Pet Runner offers fun for all ages!

title: Draw Weapon Fight Party
description: In Draw Weapon - Fight Party, you can draw your own weapons. Feel free to write your weapon, but keep an eye on the amount of ink left. Your creativity determines your combat style. Enter the 3D battle arena and fight against other opponents in an action-packed showdown. Draw precisely, craft the ultimate weapon, and crush your opponents to become the ultimate warrior.

title: Dice Fusion
description: Dice Fusion is a casual game with puzzle content. The game is easy to understand and use the game mechanism, as well as highly strategic gameplay, colorful vision and with a leisurely background sound, to bring users visual and auditory dual enjoyment, so as to achieve the relaxation of the user's physical and mental needs.

title: Stickman Warrior Way
description:
Epic battles, complex labyrinths with multiple paths and treacherous enemies await you in the game!

You will have to pass difficult tests in the fight against an ancient evil that wants to destroy all existing worlds.
 Only you can prevent the destruction of the universe and save other worlds from destruction.

18 challenging levels and mazes are waiting for you.
2 or more ways to pass the level
Save this world to give the rest of the universe a chance!

title: Hero Tower Wars Merge Puzzle
description: Join the exciting world of Hero Tower Wars - Merge Puzzle! Here is filled with tower defense strategy and merging games. Being careful of strategy and quick thinking are important. You'll play as a brave hero, battling enemies in layers of towers by mergers and digital strategies. Each tower has a different number of enemies. Use every number and a stronger sword to defeat enemies.

title: Geometry Tower Defense
description: Fast, stylish tower defense game where geometric towers blast incoming enemies along winding paths. Build on key spots, upgrade and sell towers, manage gold, and survive wave after wave. Use speed controls to handle pressure and protect your base.

title: Burger Tycoon
description: Start your journey as the owner of a small burger joint and work your way up to building a massive fast food empire! Take full control of every aspect of the business—from grilling delicious burgers and serving customers to managing staff and expanding your restaurant chain. Upgrade your kitchen, optimize your workflow, and attract more customers to grow your brand. Can you turn your humble burger stand into the ultimate fast food empire?

title: Brain Find Can You Find It
description: Brain Find brings new brain puzzles! Combine brain power and discovery for a brain challenge like no other! You can use your brain and reverse thinking to get the final target item. The unexpected way of passing levels can bring you endless laughs.  The game tests your logical thinking skills, reflexes as well as memory and creativity. Come and experience it and prove that you are the smartest!

title: Arrow Slide Puzzle
description:
Arrow Slide Puzzle — Logic Puzzle Game
Arrow Slide Puzzle is a clean and engaging logic puzzle game where you slide arrows across the board to clear the field and reveal a hidden picture. Simple rules turn into deep challenges that test your logic, planning, and spatial thinking. Perfect for fans of arrow puzzles, sliding logic games, and relaxing brain teasers.

? Download now and start solving today!

title: Dead Brain
description:
“Dead Brain” puts you in the shoes of a fearless farmer standing between your crops and the undead hordes. With simple controls and intense action, players must strategically use random upgrades to survive each wave and push their limits. 
After each victorious wave, you'll get to choose a random bonus to aid your survival. Gain a new weapon, heal your hero, repair your defenses, or even boost your health!
Are you ready to defend your farm and become the ultimate zombie-slaying hero?

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: World Soccer
description:
There are four objects, pull the object you want and fire it.
The object moves and pushes the other object or ball away
If you push the ball into the net before the opponent, you win!

title: 2248 Blast
description: Are you ready to train your brain while having fun? 2248 Blast is a highly addictive number-connecting puzzle game designed to relax your mind and sharpen your logic skills! With simple swipe controls and engaging gameplay, this game is perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages.

title: Forest Tiles
description: There are several coins on the 9 by 9 playing field. It is necessary to place the blocks on the playing field in such a way as to completely assemble a vertical or horizontal line. Gold coins can be used to reset unnecessary blocks and continue the game if you lose.

title: Hungry Snake Io
description: Hungry Snake.io is a classic game. Here you can try three game modes, Endless mode, Toilet Man, and Monster Brawl. Please note that there can be no collision between worms! In addition, our team takes user experience very seriously, we are always happy to improve the game so that every player can have a better gaming experience, if you encounter any difficulties during the game, please feel free to leave us a message!

title: Tiles Matching
description:
Free online game Tiles Matching - play in the browser without downloading. It is suitable for the development of logic for both adults and children - an ideal timekiller.
Tiles Matching is a puzzle game combining the game mechanics of Mahjong and Three in a Row (Match-3). A logical educational game for children and adults. With each level, the difficulty increases - not everyone can complete the game the first time. Challenge your intelligence.

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Tricky Shots
description: This game is about you trying to make the best possible shot. Click and or tap on the marble to begin the aim and drag back for power. Release to shoot.

title: Food Card Sort
description: Food Card Sort is a unique and challenging 3D puzzle game that tests players' logic and reasoning skills. With a variety of food cards, each card displaying a different type of food, players must categorize them by placing similar foods together on the corresponding plate to pass each level.

title: Monster Slayers
description: Monster Slayers is a single‑player mobile roguelike RPG where you must survive endless waves of monsters all by yourself. Every run is a new chance to build the perfect hero, outplay growing hordes, and prove that one warrior can stand against an entire army.

title: Merge Haven
description: Merge items to restore the café to its former glory, uncover hidden secrets, and discover its mysterious past. Start merging today to reveal the café's enchanting story!

title: Heroic Knight
description: Guide the noble knight through peril and claim the treasure! In this exciting puzzle game, you'll shift barriers to clear a path to victory. Help the knight defeat enemies, avoid traps, and uncover hidden riches. Plan your moves carefully, as one wrong decision could cost you the treasure!

title: Coe Snake
description: Coe Snake brings the classic snake game with new challenges! Collect fruits, dodge meteors, walls, bombs, and balls that move like ping pong. Multiple modes, scenarios, and fruits to choose from. Fast-paced, colorful, and addictive — how far can you go?

title: Mahjong Sort Puzzle
description: This is an addictive matching puzzle game. If you are a mahjong fan and love matching games, this game is for you. You need to sort out the mahjongs, sort out the mahjongs with the same colour into a grid and they will all be eliminated. While playing the game, you will also exercise your logical thinking and spatial sense. So, come and join the challenging world of gaming.

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: Perfect Shot
description:
Step into Perfect Pocket, a unique puzzle game inspired by classic pool, but with a twist – you only get one shot to clear each level! Test your aim, plan your angles, and pocket all balls in a single move. 
Game Highlights :- 
One-Shot Levels: Every level challenges you to pocket all balls with just one shot. 
Realistic Physics: Feel the true motion and collision of balls. Many Unique Levels: Each with different layouts and increasing difficulty.

title: GT Drift Most Wanted
description:
Drift your way around each level and hit all the snow piles while avoiding barriers. With responsive controls and a focus on timing and precision, players must master their drifting skills to clear each stage and become the ultimate Drift Master.
In this game, players can purchase different cars, each offering a unique driving experience. There’s no customization—just pick your favorite car and hit the track!

title: Road Of Fury 4
description: Road Of Fury 4 is a scroller shooter game set in a world of post-apocalypse. Team-up with other nomads, upgrade cars, guns and super-powers and use your skills to fight through 30 levels and 3 bosses.

title: GMOD Bombs
description:
Experience the power of a high-tech laser cannon in the GMOD Bombs! Collect bombs, create cities, and aim to destroy objects on the map and enjoy spectacular explosions.
GMOD Bombs is an exciting game where you take on the role of a bombardier armed with a futuristic laser cannon. Your task is to collect bombs and strategically destroy various objects and structures on the map. Each bomb has a unique flight trajectory and blast radius, which requires precision and aiming skills.

title: Space Pin Master - Pull Pin Puzzle
description: Relax and challenge your brain with Space Pin Master! Enjoy satisfying pull pin puzzles in a space adventure full of gravity-based fun. Free the balls, avoid bombs and obstacles to fill the spaceship. Spin to win coins and unlock new balls, pins, spaceships, and themes. Simple yet addictive gameplay with stunning graphics and innovative levels. Ready to become the pull pin master? Jump in and start the space puzzle adventure!

title: Kawaii Claw Merge
description:
The cutest merging adventure has arrived, featuring some of the most colorful Kawaii plushies around! 

Show off your merging skills by combining smaller Kawaii plushies to get a bigger plushy! Can you discover the biggest plushy of them all?

Ready for a serious dose of cuteness?
Play Kawaii Merge now - and let the merging magic begin!

title: Paint Rush
description: White houses are boring. Bring the colors in and paint everything in seconds. Complete every level painting all white spaces. Swipe left, right, up and down and fill all the empty spots on Paint Rush

title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
description: Begin a fruity puzzle adventure. Princess Rescue Fruit Connect is a delightful match puzzle game where your mission is to rescue a beautiful princess by matching fruits and solving tricky levels. Connect two identical fruits to eliminate them. But notice clearing the board before time runs out. All while progressing to rescue the princess.

title: Dinosaur Rampage
description: When the rampage ends, you’ll compete against other dinosaurs in the same arena and get ranked based on your destruction performance. Unlock many different dinosaur types, collect cool skins in the shop, and prove you’re the ultimate king of chaos. Fast, satisfying, and perfect for stress relief—just stomp, smash, and climb the leaderboard!

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Doge Match
description: Welcome to Doge Match, a delightful and addictive puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! With 36 meticulously crafted levels, Doge Match offers a unique and challenging experience for players of all ages.

title: Angry Flappy
description: "Angry Flappy is a fast-paced twist on the classic game, where players not only navigate through obstacles but also shoot bullets to destroy enemies and barriers. Get ready for an action-packed flying adventure!"

title: Fill & Sort Puzzle
description: Fill & Sort Puzzle is a cozy puzzle game where players have to sort, stack, and pleasantlarrange household items while watching for a naughty cat who likes to make things messy!  Many small details need to be paid attention to in the levels. For example, when organizing the shoe rack, don’t forget to clean the dirty shoes before storing them. Do you need a hint? Watch the video for tips.

title: Huggy Wuggy Guess the right door
description: In Huggy Wuggy -Guess the right door you have to find your way through a maze like factory, choosing the right way. In each room there are 3 doors, but behind one of them you will find Huggy Wuggy. You have to go through 50 rooms if you want to find the exit. Try your best and leave this haunted place as fast as you can!

title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
description: The game is a fun, puzzle-based merging game where players control a dropper that releases animals onto the field. Players must carefully move the dropper to align and drop matching animals. When two of the same type collide, they merge into a higher-level animal. The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: Mahjong Stack
description: Mahjong Stack is a unique tile-matching game featuring realistic 3D mahjong tiles. Unlike classic match-3, blocks appear in stacked piles. Match identical tiles and drag groups of three to the tray to clear. Use boosters to speed up progress. Dive in and enjoy!

title: MeatRider
description: Welcome to "MeatRider" — an intense action-packed game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. You find yourself right in the middle of the chaos, where your only goal is to survive at all costs. Choose one of the unique combat vehicles, each with its own special abilities and weapons, and get ready for dynamic battles across a zombie-infested desert landscape.

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.
This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.
Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

title: Cannons Blast 3D
description: Cannons Blast 3D plays like another tower defense puzzle game. With a heavy machine gun and a cannon, you need to eliminate all incoming enemy units before they get close to your castle. Your weapon has limited ammo and reloading speed. It is necessary to make a choice of fire coverage. When you earn enough gems, you can buy the other 2 weapons and upgrade your current ones. It is time to test your shooting skills!

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Dummies World Cup
description: Dummies World Cup is a fun HTML5 football game for all ages! Choose your favorite team from 32 national squads and control your silly dummy player on a mini soccer field. Score goals, enjoy simple controls, and have fast-paced football fun. Easy to play, perfect for kids and families!

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Candy Match 4
description: The long-awaited sequel to our popular Match 3 game! Candy Match 4 takes you on a delightful journey through the world of delicious candies. With incredible 4000+ levels you will enjoy endless fun combining candies, completing Daily Missions and Challenges, and discovering gifts along the way. Meet your friend Luffy the cat, who helps you navigate through tricky blockers and master the game. Experience one of the best Match 3 games ever!

title: Relay Race
description: Relay race game is an engaging and addictive game that combines puzzle solving elements, casual gameplay and exciting race challenges. This game offers players a unique combination of fun puzzles and trolls for a thrilling and engaging gaming experience.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description: Designed for those who love ball games with realistic physics and elements, the goal of this game is to roll to the finish line without falling into the water. Master the control of the ball and collect coins on your route to unlock new balls, tail tracks and sky packages. You can play the game in 1 player mode or 2 player racing mode. Enjoy realistic nature, physics and effects in dozens of different levels!

title: Block Puzzle Travel
description:
The goal of the game is to destroy as many blocks as possible. By doing so, you will earn points for completing the game perfectly.
By solving puzzles, you train your attention, thought processes and brain.
In this game you have to achieve the maximum result, and pass all levels.

title: Dynamons 10
description: Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 10! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Gold Temple world and the bonus cave. Encounter Tyrexar, Tyceratox, Cobragora, Pterodanox, Knightanyx and the diamond Guardian and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Black pink Black Friday Fever
description: Blackpink Black Friday Fever is a fun dress-up game designed for K-pop and Blackpink fans! Dive into the world of style by creating unique looks for Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, and Lisa, inspired by Black Friday’s biggest fashion trends. As a fan, you’ll get to style each member of Blackpink with a range of outfits and accessories that perfectly suit their personalities.

title: Foam and Find
description: Foam and Find is a relaxing hidden object game with a playful bubble twist. Explore cozy houses, each filled with charming rooms and easy-to-spot hidden items. Your tasks appear inside floating bubbles — and when you find an item, it flies into its bubble and pops with a satisfying animation. No timers, no stress — just a calm, casual experience at your own pace.

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Pirates Match The Lost Treasure
description: Enjoy this pirates adventure and find the lost treasure . Immerse yourself in an exciting match 3 game with many levels and excellent graphics. Solve all the match 3 puzzles and escape find the pirates lost treasure using your skills, and amazing power-ups to complete the levels.

title: Stickboys Hook
description: Swing with Stickboys and jump your way to the finish line. Stickboys needs your help. Assist him and reach the goal! Jump from launch ramps and shoot webs to get to the end. You must complete every level. Be careful — if you fall from the sky, you lose the game.

title: Merge Blocks 2048 Style!
description: ● A game with a summer atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where cubes fall and merge if they have the same number! Merge as many cubes as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Real Street Fighter 3D
description: Real Street Fighter 3D have very addictive game-play and many missions. In this you have to fight with other enemies and have to complete mission. It has many addictive missions.

title: Stick Ninja Survival
description: Stick Ninja Survival is a rogue-like arcade game with 2D stickman characters and monsters. When the Red Sun comes, the sky is covered by the Red Moon, and the world becomes extremely terrifying. People fled in fear from the monster's mouth. You only need to dodge enemies and their bullets because of automatic attack. When you earn some gem resources, you can use them to upgrade your character, Skills, and Talents.

title: Popcat Clicker
description:
Popcat Clicker is a fun idle clicker game where you tap a cute cat to earn coins, unlock upgrades, boost your income, and progress through different levels. 
The more you tap, the faster your cat grows and the more rewards you earn.
Simple, addictive and perfect for all ages!

title: Cute cat's adventures
description: An adventure game for girls about a cat, with whom you have to go in search of kittens. Colorful levels await you, filled with traps, obstacles and secrets, as well as dangerous enemies who will try to prevent you from completing your main goal.

title: Red Hide Ball
description: In Red Hide Ball you protect designated balls from roaming monsters by manipulating the level layout and placing shields or obstacles. Each stage presents a fixed arrangement of elements and predictable monster movements, turning each solution into a small tactical exercise. Success depends on reading patterns, timing actions and using limited moves to create safe zones. The game balances accessible mechanics with steadily increasing difficulty to engage players who enjoy pure logic challenges.

title: Reversi
description: Challenge your strategic mind against the computer in difficulty levels from absolute novice to expert in this classic game of flipping disks.

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Supermarket Cashier Simulator
description:
Practice being the best cashier in the supermarket. Become a mathematician by calculating and entering prices of grocery items and giving change to your customers. By playing you also improve your mathematical skills with the calculator in the game. This game is suitable to be played by adults or teenagers.

With the supermarket cashier game, you will improve your skills and concentration in calculating and also increase your level of accuracy.

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: 2248 Block Merge
description: Upon beginning to play, you will undoubtedly become hooked on these 2048 puzzle games. They are crafted with stunning visuals and user-friendly gameplay, making them an excellent option for enthusiasts of number block puzzle games.

title: Construction Simulator
description: Ready to build big and drive even bigger. Construction Simulator brings you into the most realistic world of construction driving simulation. Designed for boys who love mechanics, speed and challenges.

title: Countryside Driving Quest
description: Immerse yourself in Countryside Driving Quest, a dynamic driving game that lets you explore picturesque rural landscapes with a variety of challenges to master. Navigate through charming country roads, test your parking skills in tight spots, and perfect your drifting on winding paths. Designed with realistic physics and stunning visuals, this game brings the peaceful yet thrilling experience of countryside driving right to your screen.

title: Spider Evolution
description: Transform into the ultimate spider in Spider Evolution! Start small, grow stronger, and outsmart rivals on a vibrant track. Merge, dodge, and strategize to become the apex arachnid. Experience thrilling hyper-casual gameplay and dominate the spider world!

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2
description: Classic platformer with shooting. Stickman got into the world of Minecraft, flooded with zombie people and zombie animals. Help Stickman destroy all the infected, save Eve and get out of this world.

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure
description: Hill Climb: Truck Transform Adventure is actually a 2D balance stunt adventure game. You have 3 kinds of vehicles to transform and overpass different terrains. While keeping the vehicle balanced, you can climb different ramps and terrains. If you crash obstacles or terrains, you can collect repair plates to recover. If you want to overpass the next harder levels, you can upgrade your vehicles with 4 acceleration abilities.

title: Backrooms
description:
Trapped in the eerie maze of the Backrooms, your only goal is to escape or survive, trying.
Play solo or team up with friends in this online multiplayer horror experience. Explore surreal levels, avoid lurking entities, solve puzzles, and use proximity voice chat to stay connected… and stay alive.

title: Sword and Jewel
description: Sword and Jewel is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game where you place colorful gems on the board to create lines of three or more. Match gems in rows or columns to clear them, score points, and keep the board from filling up. Plan your moves carefully - when there’s no space left for new gems, the game ends!

title: Tower of Fall
description: In the game "Tower Fall," you must navigate a complex tower, collecting coins to purchase various outfits and weapon upgrades, while battling enemy mobs to reach the final level.

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Slidee
description: In this sliding-puzzle game you will have to make your way by painting the walls. Along the way you'll encounter spikes, portals, and collapsing walls.

title: Happy Bubbles
description: Boom! Hear that pop? The bubbles are calling! This classic bubble shooter blends quick reflexes with clever strategy. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards, claim weekly bonus and dive into a bright, cute world that never runs out of fun.

title: Skibronx Runner
description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Hidden Objects Story
description: Every scene tells a story, waiting for your discovery. Collect coins, unlock hints and piece together secrets buried beneath the surface. The mystery deepens with every level. Stay focused or the secrets slip away forever.

title: Pursuit Rampage
description: In Pursuit Rampage, you’re behind the wheel of a police car in an endless, high-speed chase. Navigate through busy streets, dodge obstacles, and close in on criminals while keeping your cool under pressure. The game constantly pushes your reflexes to the limit, with each second offering a new challenge. Whether you're weaving through traffic or speeding down back alleys, the action never lets up.

title: Void Orbit
description: Void Orbit is an addictive space arcade game where you orbit a central core and dodge incoming enemies. Tap to reverse direction and survive as long as possible! Unlock cool skins, dynamic themes, enjoy challenging modes like Echo Mirage and Tower Build. Multi-language support for global players. Free to play, endless fun!

title: Brain puzzles-Quests
description: This is the puzzle game filled with challenging, interesting tasks that will help you relax and have fun. There are games for training thinking, mental tasks, and IQ tests suitable for those who like to think. Develop logic, pump your brains!

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Uncle Bullet 007
description:
Play as Uncle Bullet, a retired spy who’s back in the game to take down rival agents and save the day. Armed with an arsenal of bouncy bullets, you’ll use your wits and quick reflexes to outmaneuver foes and rescue hostages.

Shoot your bullets at walls, ceilings, and floors to make them bounce, ricochet, and curve around corners to hit your targets.

title: Bitball
description:
A unique tile ball puzzle game from coin base bitcoin games loved by millions of players around the world. 
Make a lot of coins and become a rich. ?
 - Start with 10 and start making millions. ?
 - Coun you rech the topmillioners.❓
 - Play with friend together.?
 - Guess the ball where it will go.?

title: Count Masters Superhero
description: In Count Masters: Superhero, begin an interesting parkour adventure like no other! As a superhero,you're constantly running, jumping, and avoiding obstacles throughout the level. Such as avoiding rotating mace, cutting machine and so on.

title: Remove The Blocks
description: Challenging 3D puzzle game where you strategically clear the blocks from complex formations. Click blocks to slide them out in their facing direction, but choose wisely - each move affects the entire structure. With increasingly difficult levels, time-based scoring, and smooth 3D graphics, test your spatial reasoning skills!

title: The Final Riddle
description: It's a unique experimental puzzle game, where all you are given is the title of your current puzzle. If you get the hint, you know what to do, how to arrange the blocks and solve the riddle.

title: Meme Mukbang ASMR Game
description: Welcome to Meme Mukbang ASMR Game, the ultimate livestream mukbang experience! Step into the world of a quirky mukbang streamer, where you’ll indulge in delicious dishes and share your mukbang ASMR moments with a growing audience. The more you eat and interact, the more you earn, all while building your fame in the livestream world!

title: Bank Robbery: Escape
description: Bank Robbery: Escape is an intense FPS game title in shooting category, where your mission is to bust your crew out of a heavily guarded police station. Navigate through relentless police raids, arm yourself with the best gear, and make your escape before time runs out—or face the consequences. Will you outsmart the law or go down in a blaze of glory?

title: Plug Man Race
description: Plug Head Race plays like a collecting arcade game with battery items. To win the level, you need to overpass the finish line in first place. Each platform requires a lot of red battery items, collect them, and use them to pass the current switch. When you are weaker than others, keep away from them and collect red battery items only.  Remember to buy your favorite skins when you have enough gold coins.

title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
description:
You'll play as Obby, a character located on a tall mountain.
Various Brainrots will randomly appear on the mountain, guarded by enemies.
Your task is to jump up the mountain and rescue the Brainrots. Collect the entire Brainrot collection without falling into enemy hands!
Sell Brainrots to increase your jump height and reach the very top of the mountain. Rare Brainrot species live at the very top.

title: Cougar Simulator: Big Cats
description: Experience life as a powerful cougar in a vast open world! Customize your big cat’s appearance, find a mate, and raise a family that aids in hunting and battles. Level up your skills, complete quests, and compete against other felines. Explore diverse environments filled with various animals, from farm creatures to fierce predators. Hunt, survive, and prove your strength in this immersive wild adventure!

title: Drive Ahead Sports
description: Want to begin a pixelated sports showdown like no other? In Drive Ahead! Sports, you’ll be behind the wheel of amazing vehicles, engaging in exciting soccer matches! Enjoy the rush of driving and the fun of the game! Use your skills to kick the ball, attack the opponent's goal, and aim for victory!

title: Arcade Rope
description:
Swing between platforms in Arcade Rope! Play free and online in this rope-swinging adventure.
Arcade Rope is a fast-paced and addictive skill game where your goal is to swing from platform to platform using a rope. Perfectly time your swings to avoid falling into the abyss and see how far you can go. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it ideal for quick play sessions. Stay alert, react quickly, and master the art of swinging to survive longer.

title: Russian Checkers
description:
Russian Checkers with computer, Online with real people or Together on same screen.
Game Modes:
- With a computer
- Online
- Online with a friend via the link
- Together on the same screen

title: Robot Terminator T Rex
description: Ready for an adventure in Robot Terminator T-Rex! Enter the wonderful world where robot dinosaurs and zombies collide in a nervous battle. You'll control a terrifying robotic T-Rex, equipped with powerful weapons and amazing abilities.

title: Strike Breakout
description: Strike Breakout is an intense rescue mission game where you're part of a specialized team sent to save the President and his security officers. You ride shotgun with a skilled helicopter pilot as you embark on a series of 10 nail-biting missions. Each mission drops you into enemy territory where you must stealthily navigate through enemy defenses, neutralize threats, and rescue the hostages.

title: Water Sort - Collections
description: Sort, pour, and relax! Complete each level by filling bottles and unlock beautiful collectible images. Test your logic, calm your mind, and build your own gallery as you master the art of sorting water!

title: Build an Aquapark
description:
? Welcome to the craziest water park! ?

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

title: Xiblba Match
description: Xiblba Match Seasons 1 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the SIDM GAMES STUDIO, Xiblba Match Seasons. The most beautiful Xiblba Match. The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: Triple Cups
description:
Triple Cups is a bright and dynamic puzzle game where your goal is to flip colorful cups and arrange them to create rows of matching colors!
Every move requires focus and strategy: pick up cups from the top and place them on the stand below to form groups of three or more of the same color. When identical cups line up, they disappear, freeing space for new moves.

title: Summer Connect
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with summer theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching summer tiles with 30 puzzle stages in this game.

title: Draw And Escape
description: Car Games: Draw And Escape is a collection of parking puzzle games and drawing puzzle games. Draw Bridge requires you to draw a line across a defined area to help the yellow car to the finish line. When you meet the steps, you can also draw bridges to build a track to the finish line. Use your creativity to design the perfect path to win! Parking Jam 2d requires you to help all cars out of the parking lot smoothly and pay attention to the order of cars, to prevent traffic accidents.

title: Tank Challenge
description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

title: Magic Sorting
description: Magic Sorting is a simple and relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.

title: Football Stars Championship
description: Try a fresh take on a football game! The luck-based gameplay will keep you on your toes. Score extra points with precise shots that avoid the goalkeeper perfectly.

title: Warfare 1942 - online shooter
description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II, where every battle is a unique fight for survival!
The game is designed for military enthusiasts and those who love intense online battles. It’s the perfect choice for players who prefer shooters with detailed gameplay, a variety of characters, and customization. Suitable for both seasoned fighters and newcomers.

title: Colors&Forms
description:
Dynamic and exciting!
Choose the game mode!
